implementation: Reported CFO is preserved. The separate diagnostic subtracts only the exact SBC add-back already included in CFO once. This restores that named expense component arithmetically while retaining historical tax/other accounting differences. It does not establish a fully valuation-aligned series or cash paid to employees.

periods.diagnostic_formula: reported CFO - exact reported SBC add-back
periods.metric_label: CFO after reversing reported SBC add-back — diagnostic
remaining_gaps: Historical CFO tax benefits, cash taxes and normalized unlevered operating tax remain different; no automatic SBC tax-effect adjustment.
Other noncash adjustments, nonoperating income/cash, operating working-capital scope and investment/financing timing remain to be reconciled.
Outstanding awards and dilution must be treated separately from future compensation, without charging the same item twice.
CFO cash movements mix tax, operating and noncurrent populations; complete EBIT-to-CFO bridge not established.
Complete income-recognized D&A/impairment/lease amortization and economic-investment alignment remain separate reviews.
Unclassified financing/lease principal and FY2024/25 adopted interest gaps are not filled by subtracting SBC.
